source: scan of every text file in projects/desktop (10,473 path mentions)
principle: Graphs, scripts and pack defaults name binc-PC's paths. Every other runtime mounts data under /workspace and links binc-PC's paths onto it, so nothing is edited per machine. `~` is /home/binc on binc-PC and /root in a container, so both spellings get a link.

mounts.name: project
mounts.what: the CANALV2 project tree: scripts, graphs, shot folders, tracker, policies
mounts.note: scripts hardcode ROOT; graphs reference it ~490 times per shot set; the policy's root is ~/CANALV2, the tree in use is CANALV2_r3

mounts.name: plates
mounts.what: the served DPX plates from Tunnel, one folder per served shot, .LEFT and .RIGHT
mounts.note: linked from every shot's 02_SOURCE/SOURCES.csv, never copied into the tree; the IronWolf disk is parking and mirror only; leaving binc-PC needs Binc's named yes

mounts.name: comfy-shared
mounts.what: ComfyUI's input, output, models and workflows folders shared by every install
mounts.note: v6/v7 pack defaults write under its output/; the Mac mirror of it has no weights

mounts.name: comfy-install
mounts.what: the ComfyUI install in use on binc-PC, port 8189
mounts.note: not mounted: the image has its own ComfyUI at /opt/ComfyUI; the queue scripts default to http://127.0.0.1:8189, so pass --comfy <url>

mounts.name: legacy
mounts.what: pre-CANALV2 material linked from shot folders (LEGACY_MAP.csv): v5 lock graphs and masks, earlier 051 work, the painted-hull training set
mounts.note: needed only to open corrosion-051's v001 graph and its audit forks; current graphs do not reference it

mounts.name: panama-console
mounts.what: Kyle's repo: the production operating manual and the official deliverables record
mounts.note: referenced by policy pages only; read-only for us; not a render-time mount

not_mounts.what: paths from an agent sandbox, left in tool scripts under 80_TEST-BUCKET; they exist on no machine
not_mounts.action: ignore; a tool that still uses them is rerun with explicit paths

not_mounts.what: RunPod's stock ComfyUI template install, used by Binc's comfy-pod/setup_on_volume.sh
not_mounts.action: only when a pod runs the stock template instead of our image

runtimes.binc-pc: everything is real; nothing to mount
runtimes.mac: the mirror has the project tree without plates; nothing resolves at binc-PC's paths until the tree is mounted over SMB or the links above are made; NEXT-STEPS 'shared storage'
runtimes.docker-compose-or-swarm: apps/comfy-app/docker/compose.yml binds project, comfy-shared and plates (read-only) from the host at binc-PC's paths
runtimes.runpod-pod: a network volume at /workspace carrying CANALV2/, ComfyUI-Shared/ and plates/; the entrypoint makes the links from COMFY_LINKS; configured in the dashboard's Configuration panel and create_pod.py --network-volume
